title.narrative: The School of Democratic Participation - NYCU x Silba

description.narrative: The aim of the pilot project is to test the collaboration between Silba andNYCU with a potential goal of continuing work on a larger scale in a long-term perspective. This educational project aims to create a space foryoung Ukrainians who never took part in the processes of democraticparticipation because of the war since 2022, to get insights andunderstanding of topics like dialogue, democracy, elections and civilsociety engagement.The overall goal includes enhancing dialogue as a tool to strengthenUkraine's civil society and democratic participation of new and futurevoters. The project will be implemented in a hybrid format, combiningonline workshops and seminars and offline networking sessions inUkraine and Moldova.
